verdict.rationale: Postman documents general role/permission controls at team, workspace, and element levels and a programmatic Postman API for managing assets, which could underlie issuing limited-scope credentials, but there is no explicit documentation of creating scoped/least-privilege API keys specifically for AI agents. missing for 10: dedicated agent-credential scoping docs, API key permission granularity examples, and any agent-specific credential lifecycle (rotation/revocation) guidance.
